comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: The sociological narrative in this documentary is masterfully constructed. In a region where almost every neighboring country has faced decades of conflict, the fact that Zambia has 72 tribes, 73 languages, and absolutely zero civil wars in 62 years [05:16] is the most profound geopolitical lesson on Earth. Explaining how the "Ubuntu" philosophy—I am because we are [06:02]—literally kept a nation of 20 million people at peace is incredible scriptwriting. 👏 1!
